owners.auth: Existing MDXAuth and protected payload endpoint

proposed_fields.artifact_sha256: SHA-256 UTF-8 of one canonical serialization of the original parsed raw artifact shared by both projections
proposed_fields.recipe_key: SHA-256 of canonical resolved recipe content
proposed_fields.public_binding: Expected schema, full artifact built, fingerprint and protected combo_id/recipe_key/active_count; no protected ticker names

fields: sorted resolved legs: [signal_id, tf, kind, direction]
raw.config.event_window_d/w only for timeframes used by event legs
validation: legs indexes are integers, nonnegative, unique and in bounds
k equals resolved count and obeys current 2–4 leg contract
required activity parameters present; do not silently default
recipe_identity.limitation: Artifact binding key, not a recipe registry or proof of engine semantic equivalence across releases

hydration_gate: Reject unbound legacy schema; compare agreed schema, page, full built and artifact fingerprint
Require exact expected protected ID set; reject missing, extra or duplicate rows
Require matching recipe_key per public card
Require valid integer counts agreeing with public count and unique valid ticker list
Validate and prepare all replacements before changing DOM
Only after complete successful application mark hydrated and announce completion
If no expected protected rows, skip hydration and paid success UI

failure_behavior.identity_mismatch: existing protected-unavailable recovery; not no-entitlement or zero matches
failure_behavior.empty_source_overwrite: preserved and never interpreted as paid success

rollout.requirement: Explicit Confluence protected-asset schema transition that cached tier_payload.v1 consumers reject; new consumer rejects legacy unbound payloads.
rollout.proposed_literal: tier_payload.v2 on this asset, subject to incumbent generic-consumer compatibility tests
rollout.old_shell: Public content remains readable; protected rows unresolved

method.keyboard: native focus, summary activation and expanded state

acceptance_cases: positive-count empty list and count disagreements
old shell/new payload and new shell/old payload
failed response then valid recovery without duplicate request/controller/replacement
